resources.string: Show available RAM and internal storage below the Home clock.
Keeps Hi TV as your home screen on TVs that do not let you change it. Reads no screen content.
Hi TV is your home screen
Make Hi TV Your Home Screen
Installed from the APK alone, Hi TV opens, but Home, power-on and wake still go to the old launcher.
Scan to read the Hi TV installation and setup guide.
No inputs found on this TV
Use the arrows to move · Press OK when done
Use the arrows or tap a spot to move · Press OK or tap the app when done
Select an app to put it back on Home
No weather yet. It loads once the TV is online.
Located from the network. If that is wrong, scan the code on the right to set your city.
The city is set on your phone; scan the code on the right to change it.

Moving aerial films. They play while Home is on the top row (either row in two rows) and stop on the frame showing when you go further down to the apps, which stays as the picture; the next film picks up from there.
Bing\'s photo of the day, changing to the new one every day.
A different one of your photos each day.
Your photo. Scan the code on the right to send more from your phone.
Light taken from the selected app\'s artwork.
Not chosen yet, so it follows the wallpaper: aerial films with the aerial wallpaper, photos with a picture, starting from that picture. Choose one to keep it.
Set up from a phone or computer
Scan the code, or open the address below in a computer\'s browser, to send photos and videos, change app icons and set the weather\'s city. It must be on the same network as the TV.
Could not get a local network address or start the phone page. Check the connection; retrying automatically.
Tip: press Back on the top row of Home to start the screensaver.
What Back does on the top row of Home. Turn it off if it gets pressed by accident; the screensaver still starts on its own.

Auto plays the best this TV can show: 4K Dolby Vision, 4K or 1080p. Over the aerial wallpaper the screensaver goes on in the wallpaper\'s format, without a blink; with 4K Dolby Vision chosen it switches to Dolby Vision, and the TV may go black for a moment. 4K Dolby Vision needs about 25 Mbps; choose 1080p if films often skip.
Where the clock, date and weather sit.
Small puts the time and weather in one line in the corner. Large puts a big clock at the top of the screen, the date over it and the weather under it.
Names under every app, or only under the selected one, as on Apple TV. With selected only, the top row\'s name sits above its glass plate; with every name shown, those names sit on the plate.
One Row puts only the top row on screen, low down, so more of the wallpaper shows, a family photo say. Two Rows shows the top of the second row too. Press down for the rest.
A plate of frosted glass under the top row, as on Apple TV, or the apps straight on the wallpaper.
A sound as focus moves, and on select and Back, as on Apple TV.
The TV\'s own key sounds, as in its menus. Silent if key sounds are off in the TV\'s settings: choose Hi TV then.
Apps hidden from Home are kept here, to put back. With a parental PIN set, it asks for the PIN first.
A white frame around the selected app, easy to spot from across the room.
As on Apple TV out of the box: the selected app only lifts.
Smooth reduces visual effects; Balanced adapts to the device; Visual quality keeps full effects. Refresh rate follows the system.
This TV has little memory or an older Android, so Auto uses Lite.

Switch to this input when the TV is turned on or wakes from standby. Home still comes back to Hi TV. To start on an app instead, a live TV app say, press and hold it on Home and choose Open When TV Turns On.
Pinned inputs appear as tiles at the front of Home; select one to switch straight to it. Long-press a tile to move or remove it.
This TV is running Hi TV %s.
Your apps, layout, wallpaper and settings stay as they are.
Scan to open the Hi TV GitHub releases page for APKs and update instructions.
Cannot install? Scan with a phone for other ways to update.
The installer is open: confirm the update there. When it is done, choose Done to come back to Hi TV, with every setting kept.
Allow Hi TV to install apps in the settings that just opened, then come back and choose Download and Install again.
This TV needs storage access to save the update. Allow the file permission request, then choose Download and Install again.
The update could not be downloaded or verified. Check your network and try again, or use the QR code for manual installation.
This TV does not let apps install other apps. Update with the command below.
The Aerial on this TV is signed differently from the official one, so it cannot be updated over.
The website does not have a newer version yet. Try again in a while.
Asked before TV settings open and before hidden apps come back.
Use the number keys or the keypad below.
Four digits. Keep it somewhere safe: if it is forgotten, only a computer over ADB can clear it.
The two PINs differ. Choose one again.
Digits come from the number keys or the keypad. Arrows are four presses of the arrow keys, and a child watching sees nothing to copy.
Press the arrow keys four times: up, down, left or right.
Press the arrow keys four times. Keep the order somewhere safe: if it is forgotten, only a computer over ADB can clear it.
How many apps fit across Home, and in folders. Six shows more at a glance; four makes them larger, easier to see from across the room.
With one row, the top of the second row peeks out under the first, to show there is more below. Hidden keeps it out of sight until you press down.
Don\'t Open When TV Turns On
%1$s will open when the TV turns on
%1$s will open when the TV turns on, instead of %2$s
%1$s will no longer open when the TV turns on
Add MP4 or MOV films from the phone page. Plays offline; photos are shown when no film can play.
The TV\'s own screensaver, as it came with the TV (Xiaomi\'s pictures, for one). Hi TV shows none of its own.
Your own videos, sent from the phone, silent and one after another. They move like the aerial films and stop on the frame showing.
Your own video, sent from the phone, silent and on a loop. It moves like the aerial films and stops on the frame showing.

This input\'s live picture behind Home, without sound; open the input for sound. Going down to the apps, it gives way to a frosted background. A dark picture shows while the input has nothing to show.
When still: after 10 seconds on the top row (either row in two rows); a key stops it. Always: keys do not stop it, and it is shaded a little; it stops when you go further down to the apps.
The time over the aerial and photo screensavers. The time and place name move a little now and then, so nothing stays on the same pixels.
After this much time in the screensaver, Hi TV ends its system dream so Android can put the TV into standby. Never keeps the screensaver running.
Scan the code on the right, upload a video from your phone, then select it here.

Applies to Hi TV only; video apps keep their own rate. Unsupported modes are disabled. Auto uses the highest mode Android reports as seamless (Android 12+); otherwise it follows system policy. Manual mode changes may briefly blank the screen.
Hi TV is a derivative of Null_\'s Halo TV; current author BenBen.
Thank you for enjoying Hi TV. Your support helps ongoing development and maintenance.
Voluntary support; any amount. All features remain free.

Home Guard can intercept Home and bring Hi TV to the front. It uses Accessibility; optional recovery permissions may re-enable it after restart. Turn it off here at any time. Disabling it does not restore the default launcher; change that in system settings.
Agree and set up Home Guard
Stops Home Guard and its automatic recovery. To change the default launcher, use system settings.

Hi TV is a secondary development of Null_\'s Halo TV (https://github.com/Null9797/halo-tv). The current author is BenBen. It is not an official release.
Halo TV itself builds on the open-source Aerial project pengchujin/aerial-tv (https://github.com/pengchujin/aerial-tv). Names, code, and licenses of Aerial and Halo TV belong to their respective rights holders.
This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Null_, the Aerial authors, Apple, or any TV manufacturer.
City not found; check your network or try another name
Applies to uploaded video wallpapers; muted by default.
Fill may crop the video; fit may show black bars.
Hold OK to preview or delete uploaded wallpapers
Welcome to Hi TV. A calm home screen, smooth motion and clear controls put what you want to watch first.

Hi TV is a secondary development of Null_\'s Halo TV. The current author is BenBen. Halo TV itself builds on Aerial (pengchujin/aerial-tv). Hi TV is not an official release and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple or TV makers.
Based on Null_ / Halo TV · Current author BenBen
A rounded dock, clear app art, time, date and weather sit naturally on your wallpaper. This is a real Hi TV capture from a TCL TV. You can tune the layout later.

The top-right shortcuts open inputs, network, system settings and Control Center. There you can adjust performance, text color and volume, or open Wallpaper and Screensaver. A flip clock is available as a screensaver.
Make it yours in three steps.
Use your remote for basic settings. With your phone on the same network, scan the code on the settings page to upload wallpaper or app art. Default home and Home Guard are your choice.
Adjust layout, clock and performance in App Settings.
Choose a still or moving wallpaper in Wallpaper and Screensaver.
If needed, set the home screen and Home Guard in Control Center.
Hi TV is free. Your support helps with maintenance and improvements. Scan a code now, or try it first and return to Support in Control Center later.
Entirely optional · All features stay available
Secondary development of Null_\'s Halo TV. Compared with the original, Hi TV adds more ways to style and tune your home screen for your taste and TV.
Clock at left, right, center or top bar
Hi TV keeps the last %2$d films on the TV (up to %1$s); wallpaper and screensaver play them in turn, with a new one each day. In the screensaver, right brings a new film, left goes back.
Requested background cleanup for user apps. Android decides which processes can close.
No eligible user apps were found.
Android 14 or newer does not allow clearing other apps this way.
Requested cleanup for %1$d apps. Available memory change: %2$s MB (system-wide estimate).
Fades after inactivity; press Up or Menu to show it again. Hidden remains invisible but can still be selected.
Scan the QR code to set the weather city on your phone.
A Home with only the apps you pick and nothing to rearrange. Leaving it takes the parental PIN; it comes back by itself when the screensaver starts or the TV goes to sleep.
For children: time limits and breaks, and other apps kept away.
For older people: bigger tiles with their names and the white focus frame, nothing to move by accident.
An app not picked here, opened by a key on the remote, the voice assistant or another app, goes straight back to Home.
Home Guard is not on for this TV: Home shows only the apps picked, but apps opened another way cannot be kept away.
Minutes a day in apps and inputs; time on Home does not count. Any number can be set on the phone page.
No TV before %s or from this time on. Any times can be set on the phone page.
After this many minutes of watching, a %d-minute break.
Pick at least one app on the right first.
Home shows them in the order picked. Apps installed later are not added.
With an input picked, the remote’s input key can also switch to the TV’s other inputs: they share one player, which Aerial cannot tell apart.
The TV is on from %1$s to %2$s.
Look out of the window for a while. Back in %s.
A Home with only the apps you pick, and time limits for children.
Configure Kids and Elders mode in App Settings first
